# Vasilis Totskas — Fullstack Developer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Vasilis Totskas, a Fullstack Developer based in Athens, Greece, specializing in modern web applications with Nuxt, Python, and Kubernetes/Docker.

## About

Vasilis Totskas is a Fullstack Developer at Advisable with 5+ years of professional experience building high-performance web applications and scalable infrastructure. He holds a Computer Engineering degree from the University of Western Macedonia and is Google & TestDome certified.

## Core Skills

- **Frontend**: Vue.js, Nuxt.js (v3/v4), JavaScript, TypeScript, NestJs, React, Next.js, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Python, Django, PHP
- **DevOps & Infrastructure**: Kubernetes (k3s), ArgoCD, Docker, RabbitMQ, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, Hetzner, Cloudflare

## Notable Projects

- [GrooveShop E-commerce](https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-django-api): Multi-repo e-commerce platform built over 4+ years — Django REST API, Nuxt 4 storefront, NestJS media streaming service
- [Webside.gr](https://webside.gr): Production e-commerce store deployed on a self-hosted Hetzner k3s Kubernetes cluster with ArgoCD, Longhorn, RabbitMQ, Celery, Redis, and Cert-Manager
- [Developer Portfolio](https://vasilistotskas.com): This site — Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, i18n (English & Greek), Spotify integration, GitHub stats
